lines.en: I have no feet, yet I walk all the same.

lines.zh: 我飘过半格，影子跟不上。
lines.en: I drift half a block; my shadow lags.
I cross the grass and not a blade stirs.

lines.zh: 我走路没有声音，你听不到。
lines.en: My steps make no sound you can hear.
I hug the wall and slide along.
Every third step, I fade a little.

lines.zh: 我走的路，比别人短一截。
lines.en: My path is a little shorter than yours.
I step on snow and it does not sink.
I walk inside the prints you left.
When you turn, I am already ahead.
The door never opened, yet I am inside.

lines.zh: 我走着走着，就少了一只手。
lines.en: As I walk, one hand goes missing.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，什么都不做。
lines.en: I float in place, doing nothing at all.
My edges shiver faintly.

lines.zh: 我数着墙皮剥落的地方。
lines.en: I count the spots where the plaster peeled.

lines.zh: 有一瞬间，我几乎不存在。
lines.en: For an instant, I barely exist.

lines.zh: 我学着你的呼吸，一吸一吐。
lines.en: I copy your breathing, in and out.
There is dust here; I do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向声音的方向。
lines.en: I turn my face toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我记不起自己怎么来的。
lines.en: I cannot recall how I came to be.
I open my mouth; nothing comes out.
I sway along with the candle flame.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人，不知道是谁。
lines.en: I wait for someone I cannot name.
I reach out and pass through a wall.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓比刚才清楚了一点。
lines.en: My outline is a little sharper now.

lines.zh: 我歇着，却从没真正歇过。
lines.en: I rest without ever truly resting.
I have been behind you the whole time.
You saw me. That is unfortunate.
Do not stare; I come apart.
Your face seems familiar.
I search for myself in your eyes.
I was looking at you before you looked.
I am one brick's width away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛睁着，我也睁着。
lines.en: Your eyes stay open; mine do too.
I copy the way you furrow your brow.
A little cold hangs between us.
Your shadow moved before I did.
Do not shout; shouting draws me near.
I am above your shoulder, very light.
The moment you look away, I shift.

lines.zh: 我在你转身的空隙里看你。
lines.en: I watch you in the gap while you turn away.

lines.zh: 你的眉毛动了，我学着动。
lines.en: Your brow moves, and I move mine the same way.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，那是活人的东西。
lines.en: I look at your hands; those belong to the living.

lines.zh: 你盯着墙，我就在墙上变淡。
lines.en: You stare at the wall, and I fade into it.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过去，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: Your sword passes through and meets nothing.

lines.zh: 我散了又聚，慢一点而已。
lines.en: I scatter and re-form, only slower.

lines.zh: 我也会疼，只是没有伤口。
lines.en: I feel pain, just without a wound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己是死的。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I am dead.
My shape is crooked and mending.
Save your strength; I was always insubstantial.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我会变得更清楚。
lines.en: In pain, I become more distinct.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是我留下的一层皮。
lines.en: You struck a skin I left behind.
I retreat into the wall to rest.
This pain is an old acquaintance.
That lantern reminds me of home.
The soul bottle in your hand is warm.
I lean toward the firelight.

lines.zh: 生者聚集的地方，我就想去。
lines.en: I drift toward where the living gather.
That spawn egg has something to do with me.
The heat off you is sweet.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的呼吸走了一段。
lines.en: I followed your breath for a while.
Something in the bone pile calls me.

lines.zh: 给我一点名字，我就留下。
lines.en: Give me a name and I will stay.

lines.zh: 我靠近墓碑，只是想听听。
lines.en: I near the gravestone only to listen.
You pass through me; a chill follows.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，我散了一半。
lines.en: On impact, half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 我身上没有可以碰的地方。
lines.en: There is nowhere on me to touch.

lines.zh: 你缩了缩肩膀，我看见了。
lines.en: You hunched your shoulders; I noticed.
That contact reminded me of being alive.
I pull back, my shape askew.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过了我的胸口。
lines.en: Your shoulder passed through my chest.
Do not push; I will scatter into mist.

lines.zh: 冷气从我这边传到你那边。
lines.en: Cold crosses from my side to yours.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，影子叠了。
lines.en: Too close; our shadows overlap.

lines.zh: 我连自己的手都握不住。
lines.en: I cannot even close my own hand.
A partner? I recall having one.

lines.zh: 她也散了，就在这间屋里。
lines.en: She scattered too, in this very room.
Our children cast no shadows.
I searched years and found nothing.

lines.zh: 灵体之间不牵手，只重叠。
lines.en: Spirits do not hold hands; they overlap.

lines.zh: 别提了，我的心口是空的。
lines.en: Do not ask; my chest is empty.
I say goodnight to an empty bed.
The living do not know this loneliness.
When I scatter, the waiting ends.
I reach out; the item passes through.
I cannot pick it up, only look.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币在我手里变冷。
lines.en: The coin grows cold in my hand.
I try to cup a flower.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我记得位置。
lines.en: I remember where each thing lies.

lines.zh: 我把它推给你，算是礼物。
lines.en: I nudge it toward you as a gift.
My fingers will not close.

lines.zh: 掉落物对我没用，我知道。
lines.en: Drops mean nothing to me; I know.

lines.zh: 我数着地上的东西过日子。
lines.en: I live by counting what lies on the floor.

lines.zh: 有件东西，我一直没捡起来。
lines.en: There is one thing I never picked up.

lines.zh: 你走进这间屋子时，我就选了。
lines.en: I chose you when you entered this room.
I do not hate you; I only follow.
The faster you breathe, the clearer I am.
You looked back three times, did you not?

lines.zh: 我的目标从来不喊名字。
lines.en: My targets are never named aloud.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，是我的路标。
lines.en: Your warmth is my signpost.
I cling to the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 你停下脚，我也停在原地。
lines.en: When your feet halt, mine halt too.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔一层空气。
lines.en: Only air separates us now.
I need no weapon.

lines.zh: 你的影子，先一步跟了我。
lines.en: Your shadow followed me before you did.
When the lamp dies, I come closer.
Hear that wind? That is me.
Tonight I watch only you.

lines.zh: 你把灯放在桌上，我就来了。
lines.en: You set the lamp on the table, and I arrive.
Only you remain in this room. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你后颈，很轻。
lines.en: I lay a hand on your nape, lightly.
The faster you walk, the longer the road.
I wait behind every window.

lines.zh: 我的脸正在变成你的脸。
lines.en: My face is becoming your face.
Do not light a torch; light gives me shape.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我学得很像。
lines.en: I have learned your footsteps well.
The door shut itself, not I.

lines.zh: 我在你的倒影里多留了一秒。
lines.en: I lingered a second in your reflection.
Count to ten and I arrive.
This room has too many corners.
I need not run; I am at the finish.
Your breathing grows shallower.
I do not touch you, only hover close.

lines.zh: 灯油快没了，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The lamp oil runs low. Hear it?

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚步声往前走。
lines.en: I move along the sound of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你拐进厨房，我已在灶边。
lines.en: You turn into the kitchen; I am already by the stove.
I draw the wind from outside toward you.

lines.zh: 你数着台阶，我数着你的影子。
lines.en: You count the stairs; I count your shadow.
My hand passes through your chest.
Cold seeps between your bones.
I have no strength, only cold.
This blow leaves no wound to find.
You shudder and step back twice.

lines.zh: 我的指尖碰到你的心跳。
lines.en: My fingertips brush your heartbeat.
Whether it hurts, I cannot say.

lines.zh: 我按住你的影子，它就动不了。
lines.en: I pin your shadow, and it cannot move.

lines.zh: 你身后的空气压了下来。
lines.en: The air behind you presses down.

lines.zh: 我不是在杀你，是在借气。
lines.en: I am not killing you; I am borrowing breath.

lines.zh: 你的腿先撑不住身体了。
lines.en: Your legs give out before the rest of you.

lines.zh: 我只碰了一下，你就冷了。
lines.en: One touch, and you are cold.
Do not fear; the cold passes quickly.
This blow lands quiet as a sigh.

lines.zh: 我把手按在你后颈，你僵住了。
lines.en: I lay my hand on your nape, and you freeze.

lines.zh: 灯芯一暗，我的指尖就到了。
lines.en: The wick dims, and my fingertips arrive.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一瞬，我在这里。
lines.en: The instant the lamp died, I was here.
I gather slowly out of the corner.
The air cools first; then I exist.

lines.zh: 有人在这里叫过我的名字。
lines.en: Someone spoke my name in this room.

lines.zh: 我带着一枚刷怪蛋出生。
lines.en: I was born carrying a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落，也没有遗言。
lines.en: I leave no drops and no last words.
I open my eyes; the room is empty.

lines.zh: 这是我第几次被放出来。
lines.en: How many times have I been released?

lines.zh: 木地板响了一声，我就到了。
lines.en: The floor creaks once, and I arrive.
Someone pulled me out of a dream.
My shape has not settled yet.

lines.zh: 烛火朝我这边偏了一下。
lines.en: The candle flame leans toward me.

lines.zh: 我站在门后，等第一个人。
lines.en: I stand behind the door for the first arrival.

lines.zh: 出生时，我就已经冷透了。
lines.en: I was already cold when I was born.

lines.zh: 从墙皮剥落的地方，我钻出来。
lines.en: I come out where the plaster has peeled.

lines.zh: 有人在这里喊过名字，我应了。
lines.en: Someone once called a name here, and I answered.

lines.zh: 灰从房梁落下，我顺着灰成形。
lines.en: Dust falls from the beam, and I take shape along it.

lines.zh: 我出现时，屋里的钟停了。
lines.en: When I appear, the clock in the house stops.
The fire is too bright; I can barely see.
I have no weight; a fall cannot hurt.
Water makes me heavier and quieter.
The blast blows me apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带走一小片我。
lines.en: The arrow carries a scrap of me away.
Magic can hold me. I dislike that.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是别的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat; something else hungers.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我整片都透了。
lines.en: One flash and I am lit clean through.
The void is quiet, like going home.
